design: Three sequential single-hypothesis batches, first with2 challengers, subsequent1 each; all parameters and stage baselines frozen before first new outcome. Comparisons share already-inspected history and are not independent blind trials. No choosing stage winners or retuning.

shared.human_request: 按照顺序依次补充；现有基础已经够了；停止题材时点专项采集
shared.target: next official session previous-limit-pool return median >0; finite <=0 is nonpositive; missing remains unknown
shared.preprocessing: training-only median+missing indicators+StandardScaler; all-empty training columns dropped and recorded; at least one known original level per feature row
shared.training: exact official prior signal feature/next target pair; target end-date<=current signal; last120 or252 official end-dates as specified; min60 finite target pairs

LR.threshold: raw positive class score >0.5; tie nonpositive

shared.one_class_LR: explicit Laplace TRAIN_PRIOR (positive_count+1)/(n+2), no pretend fitted classifier; not calibrated; retain ONE_CLASS_TRAIN_PRIOR status
shared.nonconvergence: unknown; never substitute failed fitting with a successful forecast

KNN.distance: squared Euclidean on same training-only transformed8levels plus missing indicators

shared.current_all_missing: unknown for all challengers; every original date retained
chronology: direct direction classification and analog days
shared.metrics: Accuracy,Balanced Accuracy,positive Precision/complete Recall,F1,nonpositiveRecall,FPR,full scoring coverage,positive call fraction; all-positive/nonpositive baselines; raw-score Brier and logloss only as uncalibrated diagnostics
shared.probability_boundary: internal raw class scores and neighbor fractions are not calibrated market probabilities; none written to production plans or watch-card scores

bootstrap.missing_dates: retain full official grid before circular block resampling

shared.ending_condition_per_stage: one specified comparison and related checks/report; stop without changing parameters, or30min at recoverable node
shared.expected_improvement: test better same-target direction correctness/weak-feedback recognition; no promised percent

stages.hypothesis: Direct direction objective or historical local analogs can improve the existing Ridge120 sign forecast on identical dates
stages.primary_metric: same-date Accuracy difference challenger minus baseline
stages.gate: evaluation>=60; Accuracy difference family-adjusted lower>0; Balanced Accuracy and nonpositiveRecall not lower; scoring coverage not lower; development Accuracy not lower

stages.hypothesis: One predeclared negative-class cost can reduce weak-feedback days miscalled positive without lowering total correctness
stages.primary_metric: same-date FPR difference challenger minus baseline; condition actual<=0
stages.gate: evaluation>=60 paired and>=20 nonpositive; FPR adjusted upper<0; total Accuracy and Balanced Accuracy not lower; scoring coverage not lower; development FPR not higher

stages.hypothesis: A fixed252-session training window can improve direct direction forecast stability versus120
stages.primary_metric: same-date Accuracy difference challenger minus baseline
stages.gate: evaluation>=60; Accuracy difference adjusted lower>0; Balanced Accuracy and nonpositiveRecall not lower; coverage not lower; development Accuracy not lower; >=4 months with>=10 pair dates improve and no choosing months
